visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white tabby cat is lying on a light-colored plush cushion in a domestic living room. The cat opens its mouth wide in a large yawn, showing its teeth and pink tongue. Behind the cat, a black tabletop holds a tall floral vase and a potted orchid. (2) The cat sits up slightly and begins grooming its right front paw. It licks the paw thoroughly with its tongue, exhibiting focused, repetitive movements. The lighting is soft and natural, illuminating the cat's fur texture. (3) The cat pauses its grooming to look directly into the camera lens. Its ears are perked up, and it maintains a steady gaze for several seconds with a neutral expression. A yellow graphic question mark is overlaid near its head. (4) The cat resumes grooming its face, using its saliva-dampened paw to rub over its eyes and forehead. It tilts its head side to side to reach different areas of its face, displaying flexible body movements. (5) The cat looks back at the camera again while sticking its tongue out briefly in a licking motion. It appears somewhat distracted by the filming process. Traditional Chinese variety-style text overlays appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (6) The cat finishes its grooming session and lets out one final, deep yawn before resting its chin back down on the cushion, appearing relaxed and sleepy.
